artworks.title: LONELY
artworks.medium: Photographic print on Canadian maple skateboard deck
artworks.mediumNote: Also described by the artist as "Photography & vinyl on skateboard deck" and "Photographic print on skateboard deck (vinyl)".
artworks.statement: A study in solitude, space and perspective.
description: An original photograph of an expansive blue sea, pale sky and solitary sailboat.
The photograph has been reproduced on the underside of a skateboard deck.
The artwork explores solitude, distance, scale and perspective.

artworks.title: JUSTICE
artworks.medium: Photographic print on nine Canadian maple decks (3 × 3), with artist-applied red spray paint, custom frame and concealed mounting
artworks.statement: A commentary on power, blindness and accountability.
description: An exploration of justice, blindness, power and accountability.
The concept uses a photograph of a sculptural figure holding a gold sword, with a red painted intervention across the eyes.
Proposed formats include a single skateboard deck and a nine-deck installation arranged in a 3 × 3 composition.

artworks.title: SHADES OF
artworks.medium: Acrylic on Canadian maple skateboard decks (or high-quality printed edition)
artworks.statement: A colour study in six parts, inspired by Sanzo Wada's Dictionary of Colour Combinations. A meditative exploration of harmony, contrast and emotion.
description: A series of six concentric abstract compositions exploring colour relationships, contrast and emotional perception.
The designs use smooth colour fields without rhinestone or bead textures.
The colour relationships are informed by research into Sanzo Wada's Dictionary of Color Combinations.
toSupply: Original design files for the six colour studies (the current deck visuals are small crops from the collection board)

artworks.title: AURA 001
artworks.medium: Interactive installation (art and technology): Raspberry Pi 4, Dell 24 Plus S2425HSM display; two-way mirror surface in testing
artworks.statement: Technology is the medium. Emotion is the outcome.
description: An interactive artwork exploring the relationship between digital imagery, reflection and human presence. AURA exists between a functional mirror and an art installation.

Its natural state is ART: one artwork occupies the full surface, without a clock, interface or unnecessary information. When someone asks for the mirror, the artwork recedes and their reflection emerges. When that interaction ends, ART returns.
ART and MIRROR are not two unrelated apps. They are two states of the same physical object.
